summary: Plaintiffs raised fees in their opening proposals, and the parties negotiated fees alongside class relief before agreeing on the class fund. Whitcombe Reyes considered its own fee in choosing its counterproposal, while defense selected the lowest-outlay settlement among competing counsel. The transcript does not show a fee-for-class-relief trade, fee-based defense leverage, or a misleading court declaration.
